description.value: TurF is a three-in-one community space in the Kitsilano neighbourhood combining a fitness studio, a plant-forward bistro and cafe, and a boutique shop, operating since 2017. The bistro serves food and specialty coffee with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options, making it a natural stop on the popular West 4th Avenue cycling corridor. It has been featured by Elle Canada as one of Vancouver's best pilates studios, reflecting its wellness-oriented identity.
